visualReview.notes: Inspected all12 final portable views. Six round east towers, crenellated Trovador, three open courts, lobed Taifa porticos, tiled wings and contrasting flat contemporary hall remain readable. The inspected exterior picture supports the warm masonry, tower crowns and raised scarp.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected all12 final shared-material views. Sandstone, plaster, brick, tile, wood and aggregate graphs are reused with explicit glass/foliage color slots. True entrance/arcade openings and court roof holes remain intact. Retained map outline supports approximate east-facing placement; material cache reuse and unload passed.

mediumFiReview.notes: Inspected all28 final medium-fi views across noon/late light, high/economy quality, identity cameras, silhouette and four matched levels. Palace masses stay consistent. The raised scarp reaches coarse PMTiles ground, access bridges slope toward it, and duplicate moat grass and outer terrain walls are omitted.

geographicReview.notes: The inspected exterior picture supports six round crenellated east towers, warm pale masonry and a raised scarp. Retained east/south map coordinates set approximate footprint, scale and entrance orientation. Standard viewer PMTiles supply the ground; the derivative retains palace geometry and bounded scarp, omits duplicated moat grass/outer terrain walls and slopes the access bridges toward coarse approach ground. Courtyard floors stay above sampled terrain. The original detailed source master remains reproducible. Anchor -0.897048689,41.656484624; heading 0; standard PMTiles datum 206.4844743505745m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground.

fidelityReview.notes: Approximate exterior and fit from reference picture pixels and standard viewer PMTiles. Reconstructed platform atY5.5 retains open courts above coarse ground. Excavated dry moat, detailed inscriptions/restoration, interiors and collision are excluded; no host terrain cutout or bespoke survey. Footprint replacement stays off; physical-device timing unmeasured.

legacyFidelityScope.notes: Primary regional heritage/museum photographs, original map coordinates, restoration architects’ modern hall photos and section drawing, and Sobradiel’s published Trovador dimensions guide this multi-period exterior. The tower-width18.317m map versus16.5m published discrepancy is explicitly unresolved. Other heights, roof partitions, arches/aperture and backing-door counts/positions, columns, modern fixtures and moat are estimates. Full interior rooms, historic ornament/inscriptions, exact restoration state and walkable circulation remain incomplete. No full site-fidelity approval.
